title: Alone At Sea - Extreme Survival Game set on the Pacific Ocean
author: Longjumping-Tax-6680
selftext:
Hi Guys, I've been making mobile games since 2013, and always been a fan of survival games and played most of them. 

With the rise of AI I wanted to make a survival game which I felt was missing, since most survival games focus to much on grinding resources or turning into a basic FPS game in the end IMO. 

So I made Alone At Sea, you play as the sole survivor of a freight ship crew and you have been stranded on a life boat all alone in the middle of the Pacific. The game focuses a lot on the survival aspect of it and you need to use the sun and stars to navigate and you only have one life, so when you die you die. 

The game is built in Godot by the assistance of Claude and manually reviewing and alter things in Godot by me, I started a bit before Fable 5 was released, and since then the incremental steps of how good the models have become is astronomical. For the 3D models I mainly used Tripo and Blender, specifically with the Higgsfield MCP integrated in Claude. If you want to ask questions about how I did stuff in the game I'm happy to tell you more.

I just released the Demo on Steam and I'm working a lot of improving the game based on feedback and making the story better. 

If anyone want to check out the demo and give some feedback here is the link: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5489670/Alone\_at\_Sea/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5489670/Alone_at_Sea/)
